quote: (ii) Intel Member also hereby agrees to make advances to the Company from time to time to fund the Operating Account, not to exceed at any time the aggregate principal amount of three hundred million dollars ($300,000,000) (the "Line of Credit"), the proceeds of which shall be used to fund amounts hereunder required or permitted to be paid using funds in the Operating Account, and seventy-five million dollars ($75,000,000) of which shall be funded to the Operating Account at the Closing. Two hundred twenty-five million dollars ($225,000,000) of the Line of Credit shall be revolving. The Company's obligation to repay advances under the Line of Credit shall be evidenced by a promissory note executed on the date of the Closing.
